Plugin.Name: Docker Batch Update
Plugin.Overview: Pick which Docker containers to update and update them in one go. Adds a "Batch Update" tab to the Docker page: tick the containers that have an update pending and they are updated one after another, in order, using Unraid's own update routine. Supports select all, a manual update check, and force-updating containers that are already current. Containers Unraid can't update itself (Docker Compose, no template) are shown greyed out with the reason.
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: docker update bulk batch multiple selected containers
